title: Differentiating novel coronavirus pneumonia from general pneumonia based on machine learning
summary: The paper reports a 100-patient classification of COVID-19 versus general pneumonia on CT: 73 COVID and 27 general pneumonia cases, with ground-glass-opacity regions of interest, 34 texture features, ReliefF selection and bagged-tree, SVM, logistic-regression, decision-tree and kNN classifiers under tenfold cross-validation; the best reported accuracy was 94.16%, with sensitivity 88.62%, specificity 100% and AUC 0.99. The single-center small cohort limits transportability.
